name: ZC412369 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy ZC412369, seen by Hubble.
label: zc412369-hubble
story: Hubble came here for ZC412369, one of a set of massive star-forming galaxies from the distant past. Mapping their starlight helps show how the bulges and disks of big galaxies first grew.

claims.text: ZC412369 is a target of Hubble program 12578
The program's targets are massive star-forming galaxies at z~2 (2 < z < 2.5)
Program 12578 imaged massive star-forming galaxies at z~2 to study how bulges and disks grew
